profile_text.body:
Boston Dynamics is a robotics company based in Waltham, Massachusetts, founded in 1992 and organized as a for-profit public company. On its own site it describes itself as a leading global robotics company that builds practical robotics to address automation challenges and to change what people expect robots to do. The site also offers white papers and eBooks on the development, implementation, and value of robots and automation solutions.

The only product named in the material is Stretch, which the company presents as a way to streamline case handling and warehouse automation, describing it as easy to deploy and flexible for keeping operations moving. No other products are listed in the facts held on the company.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with a count of 187, and no individual cases are listed. No MCP servers are recorded for it.
